messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)
Used the store-orders skill
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill
Used the store-orders skill

Nicholas, your B30 hasn't shipped yet. It's on the current batch and ships October 30, along with the Power Kit and Miner Duster on the order.

Sorry for the silence on your last two follow-ups, that's on us. We wrote on September 15 about the cooling redesign and the batch move, from (email hidden), so worth checking junk and whitelisting that address, since tracking goes there too.

You can watch the batch land at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else I can check for you?
Ok
Thanks for bearing with it, Nick. One thing I'd like to know: when you ordered in July, were you planning to run the B30 alongside the unit from your earlier order, or replace it?
What do you mean?

Sorry, that was vague. You bought a NerdQaxe++ back in May, and you've got the B30 coming. I was curious whether the B30 is meant to run next to your smaller unit, or take over from it. Helps us know what people are actually building at home.
Run next to it. If I ever get it.
Used the order-swap skill

Fair, Nick. I get the scepticism after three months.

It is coming. The free Power Kit we added on September 15 ships in the same box, and the Duster, so the whole order goes out together on October 30. Your price stayed locked too.

Once it lands, the B30 and the NerdQaxe++ will run fine side by side on separate outlets. If the 30th slips an inch, you'll hear it from us first this time.
On my original nerdqaxe order I was given a $75 off coupon. Due to the shipping issues with the b30, could the coupon be retroactively added to the order and I get $75 back?

I can't put a code onto an order that's already placed, Nick, and I can't pay it back as cash either. Codes only work at checkout on a new order, so that $75 is still yours to use on your next one.

On the B30 wait, what we did was the free Power Kit and the Duster added on September 15, with the price locked. That was the compensation for this delay, so I can't stack another on top.
Ok

Understood. Nothing more needed from you, Nick. The whole order ships October 30 and the tracking mail goes to the address on the order, so keep an eye on junk for it.

A copy of this chat comes to your email once we're done here, and you can reply to it if anything changes.
So the B30 will ship Oct 30th?

Yes. October 30 for your B30, with the Power Kit and Duster in the same box.

You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
Respectfully, your email support sucks. I emailed them twice about this order status and never got a response.

You're right, and I won't defend it. You wrote on October 1 and again on October 9 and got nothing back. That shouldn't happen, and I'm sorry.

I've got your answer here at least: October 30, whole order in one box. I'm passing the dropped emails to the team so they see it.

Anything else while I'm here?
Nope. Thanks
Handed to the team · Customer asked for nothing further; flagging the two unanswered support emails a

Thanks for being straight with me about it, Nick. The missed emails are with the team now.

Your B30, Power Kit and Duster ship October 30, and the tracking goes to this email address. Enjoy running it next to the NerdQaxe++.
